cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.3.3.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "/Users/luongtoi/Documents/Projects/CasioEmuMsvc/CasioEmuMsvc/SDL/cmake")
cmake_policy(SET CMP0126 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0128 OLD)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE C)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS " -idirafter \"/Users/luongtoi/Documents/Projects/CasioEmuMsvc/CasioEmuMsvc/SDL/src/video/khronos\"")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0181 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0210 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/Users/luongtoi/Documents/Projects/CasioEmuMsvc/CasioEmuMsvc/build-ios-test/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-aD1809")
add_executable(cmTC_46f4b)
target_sources(cmTC_46f4b PRIVATE
  "/Users/luongtoi/Documents/Projects/CasioEmuMsvc/CasioEmuMsvc/build-ios-test/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-aD1809/CheckSymbolExists.c"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_46f4b_$<UPPER_CASE:$<CONFIG>>_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_46f4b>)
target_link_libraries(cmTC_46f4b  "m" )
